answer_1.quote: The goal of knowledge editing is to alter the behavior of LLMs within an expected scope (i.e., editing scope) without negatively impacting performance out of the scope.
answer_1.outputs: edited model outputs for question answering and reasoning tasks

answer_2.quote: We follow previous QA studies  and adapt exact match (EM) and F1 as two evaluation metrics: (1) EM measures the percentage of predictions that match the golden answers exactly. (2) F1 measures the average overlap between the prediction and the golden answer.
